templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S1 Identify similar shapes
templates.text: A [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm rectangle is enlarged by scale factor [[k]]. What are the new dimensions?
templates.answer: [[a * k]] cm by [[b * k]] cm

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S1 Identify similar shapes
templates.text: Are the rectangles [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm and [[a * k]] cm by [[b * k]] cm similar? What is the scale factor?
templates.answer: Yes: the sides are in the same ratio; scale factor [[k]]

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S1 Identify similar shapes
templates.text: Are the rectangles [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm and [[c]] cm by [[d]] cm similar? Show your working.
templates.answer: [[a / b|dp:2]] and [[c / d|dp:2]]: [[a * d == b * c|if:similar/not similar]]

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S1 Identify similar shapes
templates.text: A photo is [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm. It is enlarged so that the longer side is [[b * k]] cm. (a) Work out the scale factor. (b) Work out the other side. (c) Work out the ratio of the areas. (3 marks)

templates.subtopic: Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S2 Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.text: The two triangles are similar. Find the length marked $x$.

templates.subtopic: Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S2 Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.text: The two triangles are similar. Find the length marked $x$ on the smaller triangle.

templates.subtopic: Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S2 Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.text: The two triangles are similar. Find the scale factor and the length marked $x$.
templates.answer: Scale factor [[k]]/2 = [[k / 2]]; $x$ = [[k * c / 2]] cm

templates.subtopic: Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S2 Find unknown lengths and angles in similar shapes
templates.text: Two similar shapes have a scale factor of [[k]]. The smaller has a perimeter of [[p]] cm and an area of [[A]] cm². Work out the perimeter and the area of the larger shape. (3 marks)
templates.answer: Perimeter [[p * k]] cm; area [[A * k * k]] cm²

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S3 Identify similar triangles
templates.text: A [[h]] m pole casts a shadow of [[s]] m. At the same time a tree casts a shadow of [[S]] m. How tall is the tree?
templates.answer: [[h * S / s]] m

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S3 Identify similar triangles
templates.text: Triangle $ABC$ is similar to triangle $ADE$ with $B$ on $AD$ and $C$ on $AE$ and $BC$ parallel to $DE$. $AB$ = [[a]] cm, $AD$ = [[a * k]] cm and $BC$ = [[c]] cm. Find $DE$.
templates.answer: [[c * k]] cm

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S3 Identify similar triangles
templates.text: In the same diagram, $AB$ = [[a]] cm, $BD$ = [[a * (k - 1)]] cm and $DE$ = [[c * k]] cm. Find $BC$ and explain which angles are equal.
templates.answer: $BC$ = [[c]] cm; angle $ABC$ = angle $ADE$ (corresponding angles) and angle $A$ is common

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S3 Identify similar triangles
templates.text: A [[h]] m person stands [[d]] m from a lamp post. Their shadow is [[s]] m long. Work out the height of the lamp. (4 marks)

templates.text: The two triangles are similar. Find the length marked $x$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S4 Solve problems with similar shapes
templates.text: The two triangles are similar. (a) Write the scale factor of the enlargement. (b) Find $x$.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S4 Solve problems with similar shapes
templates.text: The two triangles are similar. Find the length marked $x$ on the smaller triangle.

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S4 Solve problems with similar shapes
templates.text: A photo is [[w]] cm by [[h]] cm. It is enlarged so that its longer side is [[k * w]] cm. (a) Work out the scale factor. (b) Work out the length of the shorter side of the enlargement. (c) What is the ratio of the area of the photo to the area of the enlargement? (3 marks)

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S5 Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.text: Triangles $ABC$ and $PQR$ have angle $A$ = angle $P$ = [[x]]° and angle $B$ = angle $Q$ = [[y]]°. Are they similar? Give a reason.
templates.answer: Yes: two pairs of equal angles (AA), so the third angles are also equal ([[180 - x - y]]°)

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S5 Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.text: In triangles $A[[t1]]$ and $A[[t2]]$ the line $[[t2]]$ is parallel to the base. Explain why the triangles are similar.
templates.answer: Angle $A$ is common; angle $ADE$ = angle $ABC$ and angle $AED$ = angle $ACB$ (corresponding angles): all three angles equal, so similar

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S5 Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.text: Prove that triangles $ABC$ and $PQR$ are similar when $AB = [[2 * a]]$, $BC = [[2 * b]]$, $AC = [[2 * c]]$ and $PQ = [[a]]$, $QR = [[b]]$, $PR = [[c]]$.
templates.answer: The ratios of the sides are 2 : 1 for every pair ([[2 * a]]/[[a]], [[2 * b]]/[[b]], [[2 * c]]/[[c]]), so the triangles are similar with scale factor 2

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S5 Prove a pair of triangles are similar (E)
templates.text: $ABC$ is a triangle. $PQ$ is parallel to $BC$ with $P$ on $AB$ and $Q$ on $AC$. $AP$ = [[a]] cm, $PB$ = [[b]] cm and $PQ$ = [[c]] cm. Prove the triangles $APQ$ and $ABC$ are similar and find $BC$. (4 marks)
templates.answer: Equal corresponding angles so similar; scale factor [[a + b]] ÷ [[a]]; $BC$ = [[c * (a + b) / a|dp:2]] cm

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S6 Congruent triangles
templates.text: Two triangles have [[k == 0|if:three pairs of equal sides/]][[k == 1|if:two sides and the angle between them/]][[k == 2|if:two angles and a corresponding side/]][[k == 3|if:a right angle, the hypotenuse and one other side/]][[k == 4|if:three pairs of equal angles/]] equal. What does this prove?
templates.answer: [[k == 0|if:SSS/]][[k == 1|if:SAS/]][[k == 2|if:ASA/]][[k == 3|if:RHS/]][[k == 4|if:not enough to prove congruence/]]

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S6 Congruent triangles
templates.text: Triangles $ABC$ and $DEF$ are congruent with $AB$ = $DE$ = [[a]] cm and angle $A$ = angle $D$ = [[x]]°. Angle $B$ = [[y]]°. What is angle $E$ and why?
templates.answer: [[y]]°: corresponding angles in congruent triangles are equal

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S6 Congruent triangles
templates.text: In triangles $ABC$ and $ADC$, $AB$ = $AD$ = [[p]] cm, $BC$ = $DC$ = [[q]] cm and $AC$ is common. Prove they are congruent and say what angle is equal to angle $B$.
templates.answer: SSS: $AB = AD$, $BC = DC$, $AC = AC$. So the triangles are congruent and angle $B$ = angle $D$

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S6 Congruent triangles
templates.text: $ABCD$ is a rectangle with $AB$ = [[3 * k]] cm and $AD$ = [[4 * k]] cm. Prove that triangles $ABD$ and $CDB$ are congruent, and find the length of $BD$. (4 marks)
templates.answer: $AB = CD$, $AD = CB$ (opposite sides), $BD$ common: SSS. $BD$ = [[5 * k]] cm by Pythagoras

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S7 Similarity and congruence
templates.text: Two triangles both have sides [[a]] cm, [[b]] cm and [[c]] cm. Are they similar, congruent or both?
templates.answer: Both: congruent (SSS), and congruent triangles are also similar with scale factor 1

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S7 Similarity and congruence
templates.text: Two triangles have all three angles equal ([[x]]°, [[y]]° and [[180 - x - y]]°) but different sizes. Are they similar or congruent?
templates.answer: Similar but not congruent

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S7 Similarity and congruence
templates.text: Triangle $A$ has sides [[a]], [[b]], [[c]] cm. Triangle $B$ has sides [[2 * a]], [[2 * b]], [[2 * c]] cm. Triangle $C$ has sides [[a]], [[b]], [[c]] cm. Which pairs are similar and which are congruent?
templates.answer: $A$ and $C$ are congruent (and similar); $A$ and $B$ (and $B$ and $C$) are similar but not congruent

templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S7 Similarity and congruence
templates.text: Explain the difference between similar and congruent shapes using a [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm rectangle and a [[2 * a]] cm by [[2 * b]] cm rectangle. (2 marks)
templates.answer: The rectangles are similar (same shape, scale factor 2) but not congruent (different sizes)

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S8 Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.text: In triangles $[[t1]]$ and $[[t2]]$ the sides and included angle are equal: two sides and the angle between them. Which condition proves they are congruent?
templates.answer: SAS (two sides and the included angle)

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S8 Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.text: In triangles $[[t1]]$ and $[[t2]]$ two angles and a corresponding side are equal. Which condition proves they are congruent?
templates.answer: ASA (two angles and a corresponding side)

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S8 Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.text: $[[t1]]D$ is a parallelogram (also called $[[t2]]$). Prove that the two triangles made by the diagonal are congruent.
templates.answer: $AB = CD$ and $BC = DA$ (opposite sides), $AC$ is common: SSS, so congruent

templates.subtopic: Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.source: Y11 Foundation Autumn B3 Similarity and congruence · S8 Prove a pair of triangles are congruent (E)
templates.text: $[[t1]]$ and $[[t2]]$ are two sets of labels for a kite with $PQ = PS$ and $RQ = RS$. Prove triangles $PQR$ and $PSR$ are congruent and state one pair of equal angles. (3 marks)
templates.answer: $PQ = PS$, $QR = SR$, $PR$ common: SSS; so angle $PQR$ = angle $PSR$
